title: GENERAL PURPOSES

blocks.html: The "Special Ocean Parkway District" established in this Resolution is designed to promote and protect public health, safety, general welfare and amenity. These general goals include among others the following specific purposes:
blocks.plainText: The "Special Ocean Parkway District" established in this Resolution is designed to promote and protect public health, safety, general welfare and amenity. These general goals include among others the following specific purposes:

blocks.html: (a)        to promote and strengthen the scenic landmark designation of Ocean Parkway by requiring landscaping along Ocean Parkway;
blocks.plainText: (a) to promote and strengthen the scenic landmark designation of Ocean Parkway by requiring landscaping along Ocean Parkway;

blocks.html: (b)        to maintain the existing scale and character of the community by limiting the bulk of permitted community facilities;
blocks.plainText: (b) to maintain the existing scale and character of the community by limiting the bulk of permitted community facilities;

blocks.html: (c)        to protect the environmental quality of and improve circulation within the District by requiring enclosed parking for all uses along Ocean Parkway and by requiring off-street loading for certain community facilities throughout the District; and
blocks.plainText: (c) to protect the environmental quality of and improve circulation within the District by requiring enclosed parking for all uses along Ocean Parkway and by requiring off-street loading for certain community facilities throughout the District; and

blocks.html: (d)        to promote the most desirable use of land in this area and thus to conserve the value of land and thereby protect the City's tax revenue.
blocks.plainText: (d) to promote the most desirable use of land in this area and thus to conserve the value of land and thereby protect the City's tax revenue.
